Some notable spec changes since the last breakout:

* The rule for propagating aggregates was reverted to the superset rule.
* We defined specifications for how to build the VRF tree, which was ambiguous before. Additionally, we switched from a VRF tree derived with `sha256` to a tree derived with `keccak256`. While it's ~3x slower to build the tree with Keccak, it's much much faster to generate a VRF proof inside of leanVM.
* The `MIN_ATTESTATION_INCLUSION_DELAY` preset was raised from 1 to 2 slots. This gives proposers an extra slot to receive aggregates and merge their proofs into the block's proof. This does not affect rewards for head votes.
* The aggregation committee now staggers their aggregations. Each aggregator has a different attestation collection cutoff and broadcast deadline. The times are separated by `AGGREGATOR_DELAY_BPS` which is currently 5% of the slot duration (~500ms). This gives every aggregator the same time to build its proof and lets later aggregators include late attestations. An aggregator only broadcasts if no aggregate it has received includes all of its attesters; this avoids sending ones that would not be propagated.
We should discuss BN <> VC beacon api specification, otherwise clients will come up with their own random stuff.
